result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, makes all defined Excluded Claims uncapped, retains the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and preserves the payment-obligation treatment. The changes are confined principally to correcting the deficient cap and its application to carve-outs, without disturbing unrelated allocations. Drafting is professional, though “total aggregate” is mildly redundant.
